messages:
Nora: quick heads-up — I'm assembling an interlock doc for the next quarter. need a compact view of cross-team dependencies for the Redwood Optimize pilot. who owns the risky items?
Sam: would help if we list by risk level + earliest unblock date. sample format: `component | owner | risk (H/M/L) | hard-dep? | unblock ETA`
Ravi: infra risks: GPU quota + network tenancy validation. risk H. earliest realistic unblock 2026-05-20 if quota approvals and test infra go green.
Lina: model side: we need labeled eval sets for quality gating. risk M, depends on data team for consented datasets. ETA 2026-04-30 if data ops prioritizes.
Jasper: design handoff for caching UX isn't blocking core launch but required for opt-in telemetry. risk L, can be parallelized.
Sam: runtime work: continuous batching changes touch both eng-runtime and eng-infra. that's a hard-dep for the latency SLO. risk H. ETA unknown until we freeze perf test plan.
Nora: ok, let’s capture the minimal success criteria for the pilot: 1) end-to-end latency p95 < 400ms for sample workload, 2) cost/unit < target, 3) no quality regressions vs baseline eval set.
Tom: rollout ops asks: we need a rollback plan and telemetry hooks. blocking for Dedicated/Private customers w/ strict SLAs. who can own rollout runbook? @Ravi @Sam?
Ravi: I can draft runbook with knobs for quota fallback and region failover. need someone to own the A/B policy config (which model variant we route to).
Lina: I can own the quality gating and eval harness. will need an automated regression alert (slack + console) — estimated 2 sprints.
Sam: I'll own model-variant routing config and perf test plan. can someone add expected QPS and sequence lengths from product?
Nora: attaching quick numbers: expected steady QPS 120 req/s, burst to 400 for peak events, median seq len ~160 tokens, 95th ~520. use these for perf tests.
Jasper: design will deliver telemetry mockups by 2026-04-10. will provide exact event names for console ingestion.
Tom: tradeoff note: if infra can't guarantee p95 we may ship with a higher-cost fallthrough variant for premium tenants. need pricing decision if that happens. finance ops?
Sam: flagging a sequencing dependency: runtime batching change must land before perf test matrix; otherwise tests are meaningless. that's on eng-runtime sprint 6.
Nora: proposed critical path (working): A) quota approvals (Ravi) -> B) batching runtime change (Sam) -> C) eval harness & datasets (Lina) -> D) perf tests (Sam + Ravi) -> E) rollout runbook & telemetry (Ravi, Tom, Jasper) -> GA.
Ravi: agree with sequence. adding note: region capacity check should be parallel with B to avoid serial delay.
Lina: also note: dataset consent step is potential blocker — if delayed, we can run synthetic evals but risk less representative metrics. decision needed by 2026-04-07.
Nora: action items: 
- Ravi: start quota request and region capacity check (ETA 2026-04-20)
- Sam: finalize batching PR schedule and perf test plan (ETA 2026-04-14)
- Lina: confirm dataset availability or synthetic fallback (decision by 2026-04-07)
- Jasper: telemetry mockups (ETA 2026-04-10)
- Tom: draft rollback/runbook checklist (ETA 2026-04-12)
please acknowledge in thread.
Sam: ack, will publish perf test matrix by EOD Friday.
Ravi: ack, starting quota flow tomorrow.
Lina: ack, syncing with data ops now.
Jasper: ack — adding mockups to figma and sharing link here when ready.
Tom: ack, I'll start a runbook doc and invite infra + product-ops.
deploy-bot: Reminder: quota-request-1842109876 created in infra-requests; status = pending.
Nora: great — I'll consolidate these into the interlock doc and send a 30-min sync invite for Monday to resolve the dataset decision and batching schedule.
Sam: one more thing — if batching timeline slips, we should pre-plan a conservative config with smaller batch sizes and throttling to preserve latency SLOs. I'll sketch fallback configs.
